purpose: Teach: ドナー/太陽系/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、臓器ドナーの倫理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered the ethics research on organ donors in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Calm unhurried teacher's opening, warm and clear, gentle confirming rise at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、太陽系外惑星の天文学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — and I covered astronomy research on planets outside the solar system in my paper.
lines.style: Quick bright reply, slightly rushed teen energy, pride poking through the politeness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古代の火薬製造の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered historical research on ancient gunpowder manufacture, didn't you.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower, as if paging through her work, thoughtful topic emphasis.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中東の油田開発の経済史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered economic-history research on Middle Eastern oil field development in my paper.
lines.style: Prompt earnest answer, careful with the long terms, small relieved exhale after.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ドナー登録制度の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered sociological research on the donor registration system as well, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm measured recap, gentle downward cadence, quiet encouragement under the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、太陽系の起源説の物理学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered physics research on how the solar system began, in my paper.
lines.style: Bright confident finish, a touch breathless, landing with a pleased little close.
